notes.title: Patch Notes for September 6
notes.content: Changed some alien textures, roaches may no longer open doors.

notes.title: 01DEC2019 Update Patch
notes.content:
Good evening.

The intro quest for the game is changed. This comes with new content, items, and achievements.

If you played the old intro quest and want to try the new one, go to %AppData%/Local/Spacefarers and delete or move the save and inventory files.

I apologize for the inconvenience by hope you enjoy the new patch!

I love and appreciate you all,

"The Charles"
Charles A. Debczak

notes.title: The Explorer I
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33624426/e80acfb8ba5dd6c7eaa5b91b7235c371ce18d45a.png[/img]

Good evening all! A massive content update has dropped for Spacefarers! Stay tuned for the sequel to this update in late December.

Notable changes:

- Much larger planets
- Planets save along with all aliens and furniture
- Major changes to world generation
- Generated structures added to planets
- Star systems save
- Starmap added to allow easy transit between star systems
- Lore added with a few entries (will be fleshed out in a later update)
- Tools (Axe, Pickaxe, Hammer)
- Broadswords and shortswords
- New blocks
- New ores
- New recipes
- New furniture
- New title screen and game logo
- Sulfur planets
- Bug fixes

There are likely other changes I have forgotten to mention. Like always, please provide me with the feedback necessary to keep pushing this game in the right direction!

I love and appreciate you all,

"The Charles"
Charles A. Debczak

notes.title: One Week's Update
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/947540/Spacefarers/][img]https://i.ibb.co/K5Fp6F5/image.png[/img][/url]

[h1]One Week's Update - 20 OCT 2019[/h1]

Good afternoon all,

Today, Spacefarers! has received a [i]massive[/i] content update. I wanted to see how much I could change the game to make it better within a week's timeframe. Below is a summary of the major changes:

- Brand new music to replace the old, annoying, repetitive chiptune style music.
 
- Brand new terrain textures to add details into the worlds.

- Brand new user interface to make the game look nicer and easier for the player.

- Brand new terrain generation adding ores into the worlds!

- Brand new ores: Coal, Copper, Iron, Gold, Diamond, Ruby, Emerald.

- Mining laser to allow player to destroy terrain blocks, trees, and certain furniture objects. Sold in Straton shops.

- Player can now build with terrain blocks and place furniture items (select use in inventory, then switch to shooting mode).

- Brand new trees that drop wood when hit with a mining laser.

- Crafting benches (wood planks, tables, stools, and furnaces are now craftable). Sold in Teamun shops.

- Furnaces (create items from ores).

- Player can now access the interior of their ship, build, and place furniture objects. The interior saves so the player has a consist base of operations!

- Voices for Straton and Xenu aliens (rather than on-screen text that is difficult to read) as well as v1 and v2 Synths.

- Hissing sound effect for Teamun aliens.

- Purple planets!

- Other minor changes and bug fixes.

I hope you enjoy the update! Keep traversing the stars!

notes.title: Spacefarers Update 14 OCT
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33624426/281dc1b61a482322e0918ec5fda04561ebaf3fd7.png[/img]

Last night, I dropped a brief update tweaking the introductory quest to make it more hectic but also easier. I also added an item, the bedroll, which allows the player to sleep to regain health while exploring a planet.

But more features are already in the works, to include:

Purple planets
Zootopian sounds
Synth sounds
Voices to Stratons
A new page of aliens
Other improvements/fixes

These features are already working, but I am going to add even more content before pushing the next update.

In the meantime, keep exploring, Spacefarer!
